hints.title: Sort by end time
hints.body: Processing jobs in order of finish time makes the compatibility structure monotonic.

hints.title: DP prefix
hints.body: Let `dp[i]` be the best profit using the first `i` sorted jobs.

hints.title: Two choices
hints.body: Either skip job `i`, or take it and add the best profit from jobs ending at or before its start.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
jobs = sorted by end
dp[0] = 0
for i from 1 to n:
    j = number of jobs with end <= jobs[i].start
    dp[i] = max(dp[i-1], jobs[i].profit + dp[j])
return dp[n]
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
